messages:
maya: Quick sync — want to ship a hands-on refapp launch post + short benchmark narrative + a workshop-style webinar. Goal: drive dev signups and inbound leads next month. Who can own which pieces?
sam: I can take the tutorial content and sample repo. timeline?
maya: thanks. target launch date 2026-04-14. tutorial draft by 4/1, benchmark draft by 4/3, webinar slide deck by 4/7.
ton y: (Product) i'll provide the perf goals and model variants we tested. will add the throughput/latency charts.
elena: i'll own the launch post copy and the webinar registration flow. want two CTAs: "Try refapp" + "Join hands-on workshop". also need the inbound routing spec.
kai: can do visuals — hero GIF + benchmark chart templates. need raw numbers and a short explainer blurb for each chart.
sam: for the tutorial, thinking 3 short labs: setup, run local benchmark (script), deploy to Hosted API. keeps it <30m.
maya: love that. for benchmark narrative keep it pragmatic: baseline (uncached, single-thread), optimized (batching + kv cache + quant), and cost/latency delta. avoid overclaiming.
elena: routing plan idea: registration -> Typeform -> Zapier -> HubSpot -> lead assign to SDR queue. add tagging: "refapp-hands-on" and "benchmark-interest". also push registrant slack notification to #inbound-leads.
ops-bot: webhook validation passed for zapier -> hubspot integration.
ton y: suggest we include a microcase: "how we cut per-token cost 3.2x on a 4k seq workload" with config snippet. keep config high-level.
kai: mockup request: one chart comparing p95 latency across variants and one cost-efficiency bar. will do by tomorrow.
sam: sample benchmark command to include in tutorial:```bash
./bench.sh --model redwood/llama-13b-q4 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --cache on
```
maya: solid. elena can you draft the landing page flow and share form fields? we need company, role, use-case, expected volume, and opt-in for product emails.
elena: will do. also propose an early-access tag for Dedicated inquiries.
maya: assignment recap: sam = tutorial + sample repo, tony = benchmark data & short explainer, kai = visuals, elena = landing + routing + copy, maya = launch post + operations + webinar host.
maya: quick decision on webinar format: 45m total: 25m demo/tutorial, 15m Q&A, 5m CTA + next steps. agree?
ton y: yep. Q&A panel: me + sam + elena.
elena: gating the slide deck with a practice run 4/9. adding to calendar.
maya: ok team — i'll create the calendar invite + shared drive and drop a short checklist here once ready. please ping me in-thread when drafts are up. :rocket:
